review_method: Direct visual inspection of four paired RGB/proxy frames per candidate, not full-video certification

reviews.finding: Blue/yellow subject appearance persists in sampled frames. Reference red subject has major horizontal projection discrepancy. Running limb motion is not represented by upright proxy.
Night vehicle is visible; proxy exposes seated occupants that RGB vehicle body obscures. Do not use occupant proxy presence as visible appearance evidence.
Aircraft is a wireframe box in proxy with tiny pilot visible through it. RGB aircraft occludes pilot. Box is a coarse condition, not segmentation truth.
Standing and downed character states change across sampled frames. Fine pose and fence transparency differ between RGB and proxy. Historical pose must not be treated as current state.
Van appearance persists across sampled views. Occupants are visible in proxy but occluded in RGB; small bottom-right watermark exists.
Character falls and climbs onto vehicle. Proxy coarse poses differ from RGB limb/contact states. Driver shown as visible proxy should not imply unobstructed RGB evidence.
Two main character appearances persist. Running subject proxy pose differs; building/ground broadly correspond but exact geometry is not verified. Bottom-right watermark exists.

Large near-camera red proxy body blocks much of image while corresponding RGB has no such foreground body. Reject this candidate as full-frame positive control pair; projection/visibility implementation cause remains unverified.
